summary: Winchester Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, announcing that its board adopted a share repurchase program authorizing up to 464,769 shares of common stock, about 5% of current shares outstanding, at $0.01 par value, traded on Nasdaq under WSBK. The program commences September 30, 2026 and expires September 1, 2027, subject to market conditions and regulatory considerations, and may be modified, suspended or discontinued at any time. No price or advisor was disclosed. Watch execution pace, capital ratios, and any FDIC/OCC constraints typical for savings institutions.
